description: This file defines REST API endpoints for managing user accounts, including creating, listing, retrieving, updating, and deleting users, with role-based access control, utilizing FastAPI and SQLAlchemy.

classes.name: UserOut
classes.description: Schema representing user data to be sent in responses, excluding sensitive information like password.

methods.name: UserOut create_user( payload: UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(require_admin()), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user()), )
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new user with hashed password, accessible only to admin users.

methods.name: List[UserOut] list_users( db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(require_admin()), limit: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=200, description="Max number of records to return"), offset: int = Query(0, ge=0, description="Number of records to skip"), )
methods.description: Endpoint to list users with optional pagination, accessible only to admin users.

methods.name: UserOut get_user_by_id( user_id: UUID, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(require_admin()), )
methods.description: Retrieve a user by UUID, admin-only access.

methods.name: UserOut update_user( user_id: UUID, payload: UserUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(require_admin()), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user()), )
methods.description: Update user's password and/or role, admin-only.

methods.name: None delete_user( user_id: UUID, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(require_admin()), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user()), )
methods.description: Delete a user by UUID, admin-only.
